Exercise: Latissimus Dorsi-SMR

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_isometric_contraction

Primary Muscles:

- lats

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- foam_roll

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improve_flexibility
- reduce_muscle_tension

Contraindications:

- acute back pain

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:
None

Instructions:

- While lying on the floor, place a foam roll under your back and to one side, just behind your arm pit. This will be your starting position.
- Keep the arm of the side being stretched behind and to the side of you as you shift your weight onto your lats, keeping your upper body off of the ground. Hold for 10-30 seconds, and switch sides.
